description.value: Double "R" Pizza and Subs has been a local fixture in Clearwater since 2001, serving pizza, subs, wings, pasta, wraps, salads, and more from its spot on Clearwater Station Road. The restaurant offers delivery across a wide corridor from Little Fort to Vavenby, and also has a catering service. For touring cyclists passing through the Thompson Okanagan gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park, it offers a broad menu with plenty of calorie-dense options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is real and open, operating since 2001 in Clearwater. Phone and address on the website match OSM exactly. The website explicitly mentions delivery and has 'Order Now' CTAs confirming off-premises ordering; no bike-specific amenities (rack, water, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website displays a 'Monthly Special March 2022' with 'More Info Coming Soon!' — suggests the site has not been fully updated since early 2022, though the copyright footer reads 2026 and the business otherwise appears active.
Website title and branding use 'Double R Pizza' (no quotes, drops 'and Subs'), differing slightly from the OSM name 'Double "R" Pizza and Subs'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, established pizza restaurant operating since 2001 with a confirmed address, phone, and active website. A useful food stop for cyclists in Clearwater.
